scripts.predev: npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/contracts && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev -w @ai-re-agent/server" "npm run dev -w @ai-re-agent/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/contracts && npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/server && npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run start -w @ai-re-agent/server" "npm run preview -w @ai-re-agent/web"
